mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN pos_terminal_no >= 'QPSCL01' AND pos_terminal_no <= 'QPSCL20' THEN 1 END) AS cashier_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN pos_terminal_no >= 'QPSCE01' AND pos_terminal_no <= 'QPSCE20' THEN 1 END) AS self_checkout_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pos_terminal_no >= 'QPSCL01' AND pos_terminal_no <= 'QPSCL20' THEN payment ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cashier_total_payment, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN pos_terminal_no >= 'QPSCE01' AND pos_terminal_no <= 'QPSCE20' THEN payment ELSE 0 END), 0) AS self_checkout_total_payment FROM transactions WHERE trans_date >= #{startDate} AND trans_date <= #{endDate} AND ( (pos_terminal_no >= 'QPSCL01' AND pos_terminal_no <= 'QPSCL20') OR (pos_terminal_no >= 'QPSCE01' AND pos_terminal_no <= 'QPSCE20') ) AND (training IS NOT TRUE)

SELECT COALESCE(staff_id, 'UNKNOWN') AS identifier, COUNT(*) AS total_tx FROM transactions WHERE trans_date >= #{startDate} AND trans_date <= #{endDate} AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM trans_date) IN (6, 7) AND trans_time >= TIME '13:30:00' AND trans_time <= TIME '17:30:00' AND pos_terminal_no >= 'QPSCL01' AND pos_terminal_no <= 'QPSCL20' AND (training IS NOT TRUE) GROUP BY staff_id ORDER BY total_tx DESC

SELECT pos_terminal_no AS identifier, COUNT(*) AS total_tx FROM transactions WHERE trans_date >= #{startDate} AND trans_date <= #{endDate} AND EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM trans_date) IN (6, 7) AND trans_time >= TIME '13:30:00' AND trans_time <= TIME '17:30:00' AND pos_terminal_no >= 'QPSCE01' AND pos_terminal_no <= 'QPSCE20' AND (training IS NOT TRUE) GROUP BY pos_terminal_no ORDER BY pos_terminal_no ASC

SELECT TO_CHAR( TIME '00:00:00' + (FLOOR(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM trans_time) * 4 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM trans_time) / 15) * INTERVAL '15 minute'), 'HH24:MI' ) AS slot_start, COUNT(CASE WHEN pos_terminal_no >= 'QPSCL01' AND pos_terminal_no <= 'QPSCL20' THEN 1 END) AS cashier_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN pos_terminal_no >= 'QPSCE01' AND pos_terminal_no <= 'QPSCE20' THEN 1 END) AS self_checkout_count, COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM transactions WHERE trans_date >= #{startDate} AND trans_date <= #{endDate} AND trans_time IS NOT NULL AND ( (pos_terminal_no >= 'QPSCL01' AND pos_terminal_no <= 'QPSCL20') OR (pos_terminal_no >= 'QPSCE01' AND pos_terminal_no <= 'QPSCE20') ) AND (training IS NOT TRUE) GROUP BY slot_start ORDER BY slot_start ASC

SELECT COALESCE(tender_type, 'UNKNOWN') AS tender_type, COUNT(*) AS tx_count, COALESCE(SUM(payment), 0) AS total_amount FROM transactions WHERE trans_date >= #{startDate} AND trans_date <= #{endDate} AND ( (pos_terminal_no >= 'QPSCL01' AND pos_terminal_no <= 'QPSCL20') OR (pos_terminal_no >= 'QPSCE01' AND pos_terminal_no <= 'QPSCE20') ) AND (training IS NOT TRUE) GROUP BY tender_type ORDER BY tx_count DESC
